source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("Google Street View" OR OpenStreetMap) AND (city OR urban) AND (representation OR politics OR mapping)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("Google Street View" OR OpenStreetMap) AND (city OR urban) AND (representation OR politics OR mapping),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("OpenStreetMap" OR "Google Street View") AND ("city" OR "urban") AND ("mapping" OR "politics" OR "representation"))
